metadata.dcterms:title: Hecke–Farey coordinates for Bring’s surface
metadata.dcterms:creator: Kattan1, Doha
Singerman2, David
metadata.dcterms:abstract: The modular group Γ (which is the Hecke group H3) can be used to study triangular maps, Here we use the Hecke group H4 to study the reg- ular map that underlies Bring’s surface of genus 4. Our main result is the determination of the 20-sided hyperbnolic polygon that gives Bring’s surface.
